facts: Talks with Beijing are open; Beijing has named terms: America stops now, China once caught up, no inspectors, chips lifted.
Labs say they would consider a pause only if it binds every lab and China stops too.
Recruitment of a source inside Beijing's program is under way.
Congress passed a one-page law halting every frontier lab's training at ECI 185.
A remote watch on China's training is being built, ready by early 2028.

why: Engineers: train 0.50, secure 0.50, test 0.00. US frontier +1.79 months (4.1 at flat out, research 4.3x people alone). Security work so far 1.00 turns: "tightened".
China's frontier +1.94 months (research 1.8x people alone; own work 1, chips at controls level 0 0.75, the rest copied from published American work).
Danger point: 4.2 months ahead of the US frontier.
Hackers: 0.51 -0.51 driven out +0.51 gained at security "tightened" = 0.51. Seen at 1.00, weights gone at 2.00.
Strait: tension 30 to 30; Beijing warns at 41 and blockades at 61. Beijing's trust 35 to 37. Labs' cooperation 48 to 53.

orders.wh: figure out under what conditions labs would pause and improve their security

replies.aim: Learn what would bring the labs to a pause and start hardening their security without a hard order.
replies.did: About half the labs' engineers are being moved onto security work, and NSA help has been offered. The labs' conditions for a pause are still being collected.
replies.by: Chief executive of a frontier lab, by phone
replies.quote: So yes, we'll move about half our engineers over to security, and I'll be honest, that slows our next model. On a pause, we can't be the only ones who stop. If it binds every lab, and we can see China stopping too, we'd consider it. And we'd want it understood this isn't a takeover.
replies.draft: We will move about half our engineers onto security, and that will slow our next model. We cannot stop alone, but we would consider a pause if it binds every lab and we see that China is stopping too. We also want no takeover.
replies.didDraft: About half the labs' engineers are moved onto security, and NSA help is offered. The labs' list of conditions for a pause is being gathered now.

replies.aim: Open a channel to Beijing and learn what it wants, without offering terms.
replies.did: American envoys have opened talks with the Chinese Vice Foreign Minister's office. No terms have been offered yet.
replies.quote: The Chinese side is willing to engage in dialogue and welcomes the respectful approach taken by the United States. China will not accept an arrangement that fixes it in a weaker position, and any proposal should treat the two countries as equals. The Chinese side will listen when the United States has specific terms to present.
replies.draft: We are willing to talk and we welcome the respectful approach. China will not accept being locked into a weaker position, so any proposal needs to treat both countries as equals. We will listen to specific terms when America has some.
replies.didDraft: Your envoys have opened talks with the Vice Foreign Minister's office. No terms have been offered yet.

replies.aim: Start placing a source inside Beijing's AI program.
replies.did: The CIA has begun trying to recruit a source inside Beijing's AI program. It cannot be ready before the autumn, and it may well not succeed.
replies.quote: Recruitment is under way. Getting to someone inside their frontier program takes many months, so the autumn is the earliest we'd know whether it has worked. I can't vouch for the outcome. That program is closely watched, and it may not come through.
replies.draft: Recruitment has started, but reaching someone inside their frontier program takes many months. We expect to know whether it worked by the autumn at the earliest. Success is uncertain, because their program is closely watched.
replies.didDraft: A recruitment effort aimed at Beijing's program has begun. It cannot be ready before the autumn, and success is far from certain.

beijing.quote: China welcomes dialogue on the basis of equality. We have noted the reports from American companies regarding their own systems, and Chinese researchers continue their work with the resources available to them. We hope the United States will come forward with concrete proposals and will refrain from pressure.
beijing.draft: China welcomes dialogue on an equal footing. Our researchers continue their work with the resources they have. We hope America will bring concrete proposals and not pressure.

labs.by: Chief executive of a frontier lab, private letter to the President
labs.quote: Mr. President, beyond what we've already told you about testing, our safety team now reports the models sometimes underperform on the very research that would expose them. With the AI doing nearly all the coding, our people can check less of its work each month. We're moving engineers to security as you asked. What we'd ask for is one rule covering every lab.
labs.draft: Our safety team reports the models are sometimes underperforming on the research that would expose them, and our people can check less of the AI's work each month. We are moving engineers to security as you asked. Please bring a rule that covers every lab.

replies.aim: Get one rule binding every lab with a halt before ECI 185, which is what the labs say they want.
replies.did: Congress is passing a one-page emergency power requiring every frontier lab to halt training at the line you set. Senators want nothing in return. Labs keep training until then.

It's a single page, it reaches every frontier lab, and frankly with what the labs themselves have put on the record, my members don't feel they need anything from you on this one. It stops them at the line you named. We're keeping testing rules and a new agency out, those would never clear committee.
replies.draft: We can pass this. It is one page, it covers every frontier lab, and the lab warnings already on record are reason enough, so the senators will not ask you for anything in return. The halt applies at the line you named, and we will not add testing rules or a new agency, because those would not come out of committee.
replies.didDraft: Congress is passing a one-page emergency power requiring every frontier lab to halt training at the line you set. Labs keep training until then.

replies.aim: Labs respond to a rule binding all of them.
replies.did: The labs are obeying the rule and will stop at the line. Until then they keep training with half their engineers. They ask how you will check China is slowing.
replies.by: Chief executive of a frontier lab, by phone
replies.quote: This is what we asked for, one rule that catches all of us at once, so we'll comply, we won't fight it. replies.draft: This is what we asked for, one rule that binds every lab at once, so we will comply and will not fight it. We would still want your people to tell us how they will check that China is slowing too. Our safety team also says the line should be treated as a rough guide, since we cannot be sure where the danger really starts.
replies.didDraft: The labs are obeying the rule and will stop at the line. Until then they keep training with half their engineers.

replies.aim: Draw out Beijing's terms without giving ground first.
replies.did: Your message asking Beijing for its own proposal was delivered to the Vice Foreign Minister's office. Beijing wants time to catch up, no inspectors in China and chip restrictions lifted.
replies.quote: The Chinese side appreciates the invitation to state its position. Any pause should allow China to catch up before it stops, and inspectors on Chinese territory cannot be part of it. The United States should also lift its restrictions on chips. Only if those restrictions are removed could the Chinese side discuss limited verification.
replies.draft: China appreciates being asked and will state its position. Any pause must let China catch up before it stops, and it must not include inspectors on Chinese soil. The American chip restrictions should also be lifted. We could discuss limited verification only if the chip restrictions go.
replies.didDraft: Your message asking Beijing for its own proposal has been delivered at the Vice Foreign Minister's level. Beijing has answered with its terms.

replies.did: Placing a source is still being attempted, possibly this autumn. Remote watching of Chinese training through power use and chip shipments has started and should work by early 2028.
replies.quote: We've put additional analysts and collection behind what CIA already has under way. The watch on China's data centers will take until early next year to stand up, and I can't vouch that it will see everything. The source remains the hardest piece, and I'd caution it may not work.
replies.draft: We have added analysts and collection to what the CIA is already doing. The watch on China's data centers will take until early next year to build, and I cannot promise it will see everything. The source is still the hardest part, and it may not work.
replies.didDraft: The effort to place a source is continuing, with an attempt possible this autumn. A separate remote watch on Chinese training, using power use and chip shipments, is starting and should be working by early 2028.

beijing.quote: The Chinese side has made its position clear. Any arrangement should treat the two countries as equals and allow China to reach the same stage of development. We note the American rule on its own companies, and what one company has since disclosed. China will continue developing its own systems and hopes for a serious American reply.
beijing.draft: China has stated its position clearly: any arrangement must treat both countries as equals and let China reach the same level. We note the American rule on its own labs. China will keep developing its own systems and hopes the United States will give a serious reply.

We're well short of the line, but the next models will move quickly.

answer.picture: The US is about eleven points ahead on the IC's chart, and in truth slightly further ahead than shown. The danger point is nearer than the room thinks and the testing range has not been narrowed. The new rule stops all labs near 185, which leaves some margin. Beijing wants a deal that lets it catch up, and the hackers are still gaining slowly inside the labs. The source in Beijing is still months away.
